report.summary: Registered SYN.A market maker (ETF-MM) quoting a BUY and a SELL of 2913 (its typical size) one tick apart, cancelling and re-quoting both sides together as the touch drifts down from 10005 to 10002. Opposite-side fills were small (453), the price moved against the trader (-2 ticks), round trip was negative (-0.79 ticks), and there was no reversion. Neither core feature is present, and market making is supported.
